name: Overseas Family School
summary: Central OFS campus with IB and mother-tongue pathways for a highly international student body.
body: OFS emphasises mother-tongue maintenance alongside IB programmes, attracting globally mobile families who want language continuity. The central location helps dual-career households. Admissions and language placement deserve an early conversation with the school.
